name: Campfire
licensing: Bluey (Ludo Studio/BBC) and Frog and Toad (Arnold Lobel estate) are copyrighted characters. Private, non-commercial use on a device in Tuesday's room only. Rendered files must never be committed, published or shared. If the named-character prompt is refused or off-model, use image.fallback_prompt.

image.prompt: Painterly illustration in a 70/30 style blend: primarily (70%) the atmospheric, painterly style of the animated series Scavengers Reign — muted naturalistic palette, organic textures, soft volumetric haze and lighting, subtle bioluminescent color accents — blended with (30%) the warm, soft style of Studio Ghibli background art. Gentle brushwork, soft diffused light, calm and cozy mood, no harsh shadows. No text, no logos, no watermark. Tuesday, a 3-year-old girl with a short chestnut-blonde bob haircut (a darker, warm honey-brown blonde) with a soft fringe, rosy cheeks and a small button nose. She looks clearly three, not a baby: a slightly slimmer face that has lost most of its baby chubbiness, longer legs and a taller, steadier standing posture, proportions of a preschooler rather than an infant. She wears cozy pajamas and sits cross-legged by a warm campfire at night. On one side of the fire sits Bluey, the blue heeler puppy from the children's show Bluey, drawn and sitting exactly as she does in the show: upright on her bottom like a child, back straight, hind legs out in front, front paws resting in her lap. On the other side sit Frog and Toad, the storybook characters, seated together and wearing their classic outfits from Arnold Lobel's books: jackets, shirts and trousers in muted greens and browns. Warm orange and gold firelight lights their faces from below, embers drift upward into a dark indigo night sky, a soft silhouette of pine trees forms the treeline. The group centered in the lower half, a few soft stars above. Horizontal 16:9 landscape composition.

video.prompt: The campfire flames flicker continuously and naturally; embers drift upward and fade at a steady, repeating rate. Tuesday and her companions stay mostly still with only tiny idle movements — a slight tail wag, an occasional blink — nothing that reads as a one-time gesture. Firelight held at constant intensity. Locked-off static camera: no camera movement, no zoom, no pan. Slow, continuous, cyclical, steady-state motion only — nothing that builds, changes pose, or tells a story. Lighting and color held constant throughout. The final frame returns exactly to the starting image so the clip loops seamlessly. No text, no captions, no audio.
video.negative_prompt: camera movement, zoom, pan, cuts, scene change, lighting change, new characters, text, subtitles, morphing faces, extra limbs
video.audio_note: Veo 3.1 always generates audio; build_loop.py discards it
